text:
Anika: Hey team — planning to cut release/1.14 tomorrow at 15:00 UTC. Need a quick preflight owner for checks: version bump, changelog polish, smoke tests, and backport triage. Any volunteers? :wave:

Matt: I can take the version bump and publish notes. Will do a quick sanity on the build numbers. :white_check_mark:

Judy: I can handle smoke tests and confirm CI passes for the release branch. When do you want me to run them?

Anika: Thanks both. Ideally the branch exists 1 hour before cut so we can run smoke once branch is created. So branch creation at 14:00 UTC, smoke at 14:05.

Sam: Quick question on backports — are we still restricting to bugfix + critical infra only? Or allow small UX fixes if the regression is customer-facing?

Anika: Backport policy for this cut: bugfixes, security, and infra fixes only. UX/feature fixes require explicit approval from release lead (that would be me + Matt to sign off). Keep scope tight.

Marco: One more thing — changelog: please add entries to CHANGELOG/unreleased.md with the PR link and short blurb. I'll consolidate. If it's a backport, mark it with "(backport to release/1.14)".

Matt: Noted. I'll also run the version bump in `package/build` and push a commit that updates the CHANGELOG header. Will tag you in the PR.

Judy: For smoke tests I'll run the `smoke/release` suite and post results. If anything times out, I'll escalate to eng-oncall.

Anika: For branch creation, use this pattern and label PRs accordingly:

```
# create branch from main
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b release/1.14 origin/main
# push
git push origin release/1.14
```

And PRs into release/* should have label: `release/1.14` + `backport` (if applicable).

Sam: For cherry-picks: please include the original PR number in the title and the following in the body:

```
Backport of #1234
Original author: @original-author
Reason: bugfix causing crash in runtime
Cherry-picked via: `git cherry-pick -x <commit>`
```

Marco: Also add the following CI skip guards in any backport PRs that touch runtime kernels — we need the runtime-qualifier job to run:

```
labels: [runtime-qualifier]
```

Matt: Is there any exemption process for hotfixes that come in after branch-cut? Say we cut and then a critical bug is found in main. Can we still push to release/1.14?

Anika: Yes — emergency hotfixes allowed but they must go through the emergency approval flow: ping me + release-bot + one senior eng (Matt or Marco) in #eng-releases, include justification and test results. release-bot will mark the PR with `emergency` and trigger the expedited pipeline.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: Branch cut window for release/1.14 at 15:00 UTC tomorrow. To confirm branch creation run `/release create release/1.14 --from=main` or follow the manual git steps.

Judy: Quick checklist I'm using before I run smoke:
- branch exists
- version bump commit present
- CHANGELOG entries done
- no failing e2e on main
- runtime-qualifier job green

If all green I'll run smoke at 14:05 UTC and post logs.

Sam: I have two backport PR candidates pending review: #2345 (panic fix) and #2351 (doc link). I'll only request merge for #2345 per policy.

Anika: Perfect — Sam, ping me in-thread when #2345 is ready and include `@Anika @Matt` in the reviewers. Marco, can you consolidate changelog entries after PR merges?

Marco: Yep will consolidate and open the release notes PR with the commit list. Plan to publish notes after tag.

Matt: One final nit: please avoid adding new feature flags to the release branch. Any flag flips require a post-cut rollout plan.

Anika: Thanks everyone. I'll be the release lead. Summary of owners:
- Version bump / notes: Matt
- Smoke tests: Judy
- Backport triage: Sam
- Changelog consolidation: Marco

If anyone needs an exception, ping me + Matt. I'll post a 1-hour reminder tomorrow. :bell:

Judy: :thumbsup: will report results in this thread.

Marco: :eyes: prepping the release notes draft now.

Sam: Will hold on #2351 and only merge #2345 if green.

release-bot: Acknowledged. Emergency approval flow: mention `@Anika` + `@Matt` + `release-bot` and include test evidence. Automated pipeline will run expedited checks when `emergency` label is present.
